basic_details.job_title: Armed Forces Tribunal Guwahati Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline for 2 Assistant, Junior Accounts Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 56 years (as on closing date of receipt of applications)

qualification.education_qualification: Degree from recognized University with 2 years experience in establishment, administration or accounts, or holding analogous posts / UDC with 10 years regular service.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Degree from recognized University; Having 2 years experience in establishment, administration or Accounts. Experience required: 2 years experience in establishment, administration or Accounts. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Pay Matrix Level-6 (Rs.35400-112400). Qualification required: Training in cash and accounts work in the institute of Secretarial Training and Management or equivalent. Experience required: Holding analogous post or 6 years regular service in level-5 with 2 years experience of cash accounts and budget work. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Pay Matrix Level-6 (Rs.35400-112400).

how_to_apply: Forward the application in the prescribed pro-forma (Annexure-I) through proper channel.
Include photo copies of Annual Confidential Reports for the last five years along with Vigilance Clearance Certificate.
Send to the Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Guwahati, 2nd Floor, Assam Police Housing Corporation Ltd (2nd Floor), BK Kakati Road, PO-Rehabari, Guwahati-781008.
Make sure it reaches by 16 January 2027.
important_instructions: Applications received without supporting documents, photograph, unsigned and incomplete will be summarily rejected. Candidates who have applied for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.
